propoma, propomatis n.

noun, third declension

an aperitif, a drink before a meal

Lewis & Short: “a drink taken before eating, a whet (postclass.)”; Greek πρόπομα. Nearer an aperitif than a mixed drink.

Other words

  • cinnus, cinnī m. — a mixed drink

    noun, second declension · also used · late Latin · Arn. 5.174 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 70; Traupman 293: cinnis -is m

    Lewis & Short: “a mixed drink of spelt-grain and wine”, from Arnobius and Nonius.

See also alcohol, drink.
